prompt.project_info: Create a clean modern outdoor lifestyle selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult East Asian woman with light-brown eyes, thin black oval glasses, loose messy dango-style bun, dark clips near the forehead, pink blush, muted rose lips, and a gentle playful smile, wearing a black opaque sleeveless ribbed top.
prompt.composition_elements: Selfie held with both hands in front of the chest, black ergonomic mesh chair with headrest, vibrant green foliage and trees softly out of focus, direct eye contact, clean manicure.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural outdoor daylight, warm skin tones, vibrant high-contrast greenery, shallow bokeh, fresh social-media lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone front-camera selfie, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair texture, natural color and mild phone sharpening.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clean modern lifestyle selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman with light-brown eyes, thin black oval glasses, a loose messy dango-style bun with wind-caught stray hairs, two dark clips near the forehead, pink blush, muted rose lip color, and a gentle playful smile. She holds a black smartphone with both hands in front of her chest and wears an opaque black sleeveless ribbed top. She sits in a black ergonomic mesh office chair with headrest, with vibrant green foliage and trees softly out of focus behind her. Use bright natural outdoor daylight, warm skin tones, shallow bokeh, high-contrast greenery, realistic skin and hair, and clean social-media lifestyle photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent clothing, cleavage emphasis, sexualized gaze, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
